summary: On June 25, 2026, ON Semiconductor (onsemi) filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Synaptics via a merger. Under the terms, each Synaptics share will be exchanged for 1.350 shares of onsemi common stock, implying Synaptics equityholders will own ~12% of the combined company. The onsemi Board unanimously approved the deal; no appraisal rights are available. Synaptics stock will be delisted from Nasdaq post-close. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock merger. The filing did not state a premium or fixed price. The close depends on regulatory and shareholder approvals; the risk-arb spread hinges on relative stock movements and deal completion timing.
